clues.text: Saying He was gentle and humble in heart, Jesus told His hearers to take His upon them and learn from Him.
At Shechem, Israel asked King Rehoboam to lighten the heavy one his father Solomon had put on them.
The LORD told Jeremiah to make one out of leather straps and put it on his own neck.
In the house of the LORD, the prophet Hananiah took it off Jeremiah's neck and broke it.
Moses and Aaron were told the unblemished red heifer must never have been placed under one.
Isaac told a weeping Esau that when he rebelled, he would tear his brother's off his neck.
At the Jerusalem council, Peter asked why they would place on disciples' necks one their fathers could not bear.
